verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack (logo, can, headline, copy, CTA) and the brand intact. However, the NEW FLAVOR pill is oversized and crowds the top-left edge, the headline is small for a tall skyscraper, the copy wraps with an awkward short second line, and the bottom ~80px is empty. B makes the headline nicely bold, but the SOLSTICE logo shrinks to an illegible speck jammed beside the badge in the top-right. The can is shrunk and sits left of the centred text, the body copy is so large it competes with the headline, and the CTA sits cramped against the bottom edge.
